description: Synthetic studio class marketplace for one member (Amara Bello): twenty fictional studios with instructors, ratings and script-drawn PNG marks, two weeks of scheduled classes from December 7, 2026 priced under three plan types (trial, 8 credits, 20 credits), the member's 8 Credits history from January 2025 to July 2026 with monthly receipts and attended classes, her win-back trial from December 6, 2026 with three included bookings and one waitlist place. Coverage over 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 is reported in evidence/coverage.json.

sources.description: Authored studios, plans and narrative plus computed schedules, history and receipts; scripts/generate-fixture.cjs is the sole source and also draws the studio images. Public help pages of the reference product were read only to mirror interaction patterns; no content, data or media was copied.

transformations: Schedules computed per studio with one class per room and start time; capacities never below bookings; the member's history and receipts computed month by month; IDs, dates and references checked by validateSeed.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace a human read-through of realism and variation; recorded here before submission.
